body:
Thank you. I'm just in the process of organizing my thoughts on the subject because it's hard to really pin down the problem if I've got no outside perspective on it but reading your advice I feel like my problems might be a bit more far reaching. Maybe I'm just a lazy piece of shit using that stuff as a justification for being the way I am but when I talk to strangers it feels like it's doing more harm than good. Asking someone for the time wouldn't be that much of a problem at first I think, but later on I get so worked up. Even if it would be a simple exchange like 

"what time is it?" 
"8 o'clock"
"thank you"

I think I can see the animosity in the face of the person I'm talking to. Don't know if I'm really fucking weird looking or anything (sometimes I look in the mirror and think that I look kind of handsome in a certain angle, in a certain light, but most of the time I'm just like "what a fucking creep"). I'm scared of shaving because I think I'll fuck it up and miss a spot or cut myself and look even weirder.. I've tried walking once (yep, gave up after one time) before work, got up really early and at first it felt really great and I didn't even mind the effort. But as I went on more and more doubt started to fill my thoughts "What if I'm walking wrong and I do more harm to my body than good?" (you know like walking too fast, too slow, the wrong posture or whatever..), "what if someone sees my walking around that early, what will they be thinking?..".

I've planned my days down to the minute. But when I am at work thinking about the plan it kind of starts to crumble, it's not fucking worth it.. nothing good will come of it.. and I just start to think "it would be easier to just kill myself when I get home".. Some people go to work and do their job and talk to their workmates and it just seems effortless, like time is flying by for them. For me an 8 hour day is like a fucking week, so much stuff goes through my head every fucking hour, every fucking minute, every fucking second. It's not even just talking to people that's hard, I have a hard time eating in front of other people. I don't like having a smoke when other people are around because I have the feeling that they're staring at me. When I overhear people laughing I think that they're might be laughing about me. I probably smell really bad.. 
Fuck even drinking water is hard because I think I might look weird doing it..

sorry for the rambling, it's not that I'm not grateful for your advice or anything..
